scope: YU-RIS, WillPlus/AdvHD and Softpal archive readers added after the archive coverage audit

source.file_license: MIT; complete original notices retained in each adapted module

algorithms: paired length substitution and filename XOR
raw and bounded zlib member decode
optional name CRC32 and stored Adler32 checks
changes: require version and filename key; no heuristic key guessing
scan count records without reading directory_bound slack into payload
reject invalid names, ranges and flags instead of silently dropping entries
limitations: not every game-specific scheme for those versions
does not apply YSTB ScriptKey; script processing remains separate
upstream reader ignores checksum fields; strict verification is opt-in

algorithms: v1 grouped directory with 9/13-byte names and absolute offsets
v2 UTF-16LE directory and relative offsets
bounded PSP ring-buffer LZSS including overlapping matches
changes: explicit layout instead of exception-swallowing fallback
reject unsafe base names before extension replacement
do not auto-decrypt by suffix; caller selects codec and handles Model archive exception
PSP length, truncation and trailing-data checks
limitations: archive version does not establish WS2 opcode version
only raw, script-ror2 and psp codecs

algorithms: v1 PAC directory at 0x3FE with explicit 16/32-byte names
v2 PAC-space signature and directory at 0x804
explicit script-dollar byte rotation and LE word XOR
changes: explicit layout/codec instead of guessing width or media type
preserve first 16 bytes and incomplete word tail
never rewrite TEXT.DAT marker to claim plaintext
limitations: script-dollar requires independently identified non-media member
existing script interface still requires proven plaintext TEXT and independently located Sv20 operands

shared_implementation.origin: new standard-library-only I/O for these three readers
operations: bounded exact reads supporting short reads
entry identity and unchanged file-size checks
limits: same-size archive edits are not detected
batch callers must enforce aggregate output budgets
no disk writes or import-time I/O
